verdict.line: You out-trade Camille from level 1 to 5 with Q pokes and W stuns, but once her R (The Hextech Ultimatum) comes online at 6 and its cooldown keeps dropping as she ranks it, she starts dictating engagements — which is why the head-to-head still sits at only 45.2% over 1660 games.

brief.thesis: K'Sante's Q (Ntofo Strikes) has a flat 3.5s cooldown regardless of rank, so he can poke and stack it far more often than Camille can safely answer before level 6, matching the data's lane and solo-kill edge. The matchup flips structurally once Camille hits 6: her R (The Hextech Ultimatum) dashes to K'Sante and anchors him to the area while granting her bonus magic damage on autos, and that cooldown keeps shrinking (140/115/90/0/0s by rank) as she levels it, so she increasingly chooses when fights happen instead of you.

theirWindow.what: Her R (The Hextech Ultimatum) dashes to you and anchors you to the area, and her autos deal bonus magic damage while you're attached. Don't commit to extended solo trades near her jungle's pathing unless your E (Footwork) shield and dash are both up to disengage.

yourWindow.what: At 2 stacks, Q (Ntofo Strikes) fires a shockwave that pulls her in — chain this straight into W (Path Maker)'s charge-up and stun/knockback before she can walk the trade off. This is the window the data's solo-kill edge comes from.

powerCurve.note: W stun wins every forced all-in
Second R rank shortens your leash

start.why: The higher-winrate start in this matchup (45.8% over 1641 games, 87.2% pick) — omnivamp plus Grasp of the Undying sustains you through the auto-trades you're forcing with Q.

boots.why: 79.6% pick at 44% win rate — Camille's damage is entirely physical autos and empowered-auto bursts (Q, R), so flat auto mitigation is the correct boot.

core.why: Cooldown and the on-hit slow let you chain Q pokes into stacks faster and punish her when she commits to an E (Hookshot) leap.
Highest-winrate second item in the sample (51.6% with this full path) — the damage-reduction-on-ability-hit shores up the exact trades she wins with Q/W burst.
Completes the 51.6%-winrate core path and scales your stats as the game goes long, which matters since her power curve overtakes yours after level 11.

situational.when: her R's bonus magic damage on autos starts swinging fights once she's anchored you
she's building into lifesteal or crit to win extended auto trades
you need the healing-reduction online early against her W (Tactical Sweep) sustain

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs off the autos you weave between Q pokes, healing you and empowering the next auto — exactly the trade pattern Q's 3.5s cooldown is built for, and it's the highest-sample page for this matchup (47.2% over 20.5% pick).

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the dominant pick (44.7% win rate, 78.5% pick) and fits K'Sante's scaling-tank role — Teleport lets you use your early lane-advantage window to join fights elsewhere instead of staying locked into a lane that gets harder for you after 6. Flash+Ignite (48.6%, 16.5% pick) is the aggressive alternative if you intend to press the solo-kill edge directly.

playing.title: Open with Q, not autos
playing.detail: Camille's passive (Adaptive Defenses) shields her against your damage type whenever her own basic attacks land on you first — so poke with Q (Ntofo Strikes) at 450 range before she gets a free auto in, and weave an auto after each Q to cash in the Dauntless Instinct mark.

playing.title: Chain 2-stack Q into W
playing.detail: At 2 Q stacks the shockwave pulls her in; immediately charge and release W (Path Maker) for the knockback and stun. This is the core pre-6 trade pattern behind the solo-kill edge.

playing.title: Punish her E commitment
playing.detail: Camille's E (Hookshot) requires a wall and is on a 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown — charge W (Path Maker) while she's airborne so the charge-up's reduced damage covers you, then release the dash to land your stun the moment she comes down.

playing.title: Press kills before level 6
playing.detail: Your solo-kill advantage is real but front-loaded — once she hits 6, her R (The Hextech Ultimatum) can anchor you mid-fight and flip a losing trade for her, so commit to all-ins before that threshold, not after.

playing.title: Use E on allies for picks
playing.detail: E (Footwork) targeted on an ally dashes you to them at increased range and shields both of you — use this to join jungle ganks or follow up Teleport roams rather than only as a solo escape.

playing.title: Respect the anchor post-6
playing.detail: Once hit by R, you're anchored to the area and eating bonus magic damage on her autos — don't try to walk the trade off; fight it out or use E (Footwork)'s shield to survive the window instead.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, boot/start pick rates, rune pages, summoner spells, and the 45.2% head-to-head win rate over 1660 games are measured from live match data on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning behind each trade window and item choice is my own read of the kit, not sourced from the data itself.
